power.supply: Input: 100 – 240 V AC, 50/60 Hz, 1.5 A; Output: 48 V DC, 1 A (power adapter)

features: Consumption 50 Watts stated as with HDD and max. PoE PD
H.264 recording up to 720p HD video at 30 fps, concurrent 720p recording for all channels
Max. single-camera recording resolution conflicts: TV-NVR104 datasheet states recording up to 720p; TV-NVR104D2 datasheet states max. for a single camera 1080p
Uplink speed conflicts: specifications list a 10/100 Mbps network port; TV-NVR104D2 datasheet feature section says Gigabit Ethernet network uplink port
Dimensions/weight conflict between sources: 199 x 199 x 47 mm, 584 g (TV-NVR104) vs 205 x 198 x 45 mm, 1.3 kg (TV-NVR104D2 with 2 TB HDD)
TV-NVR104D2 is the same NVR with a preinstalled 2 TB HDD
Hardware versions v1.0R and v1.1R; the v1.1R datasheets do not list ONVIF, the v1.0R datasheets and both product pages list ONVIF v2.2
Also sold as kit TV-NVR104K (TV-NVR104 with pre-installed 1 TB HDD and two TV-IP320PI cameras)
Display output resolutions: 1920 x 1080, 1280 x 1024, 1280 x 720, 1024 x 758 at 60Hz
Network protocols: IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, ICMP, ONVIF v2.2, DHCP, NTP, DNS, DDNS, SMTP, FTP, HTTP, UPnP, RTSP, RTP, RTCP
Live view: single camera or quad-view
Camera management: OSD, image quality, PTZ, motion detection, privacy masks, video tamper detection, video loss detection
